api_changes.detail: The quickstart shows an OpenAI client with base_url https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/ and POST https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/chat/completions. It also shows Authorization: Bearer $NEBIUS_API_KEY. This sample keeps that base_url.

The August 2026 deprecations page says to update the model value. This sample only changes the model field. Token Factory does not automatically reroute requests from deprecated models. Dedicated Endpoints are unaffected.

code_change.before:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)
code_change.after:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1/")
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
)

migration_checklist: Read the shutdown date for Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct on the linked official page.
This change only affects Serverless usage. Dedicated Endpoints are unaffected.

Point your requests at MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 and test before you send traffic.
